records.title: DynaMath: A Dynamic Visual Benchmark for Evaluating Mathematical Reasoning Robustness of Vision Language Models
records.reason: 一次資料の要旨・主題はLLM推論の計算量、メモリ、レイテンシ、スループット、KV cache、量子化、offload、servingの具体的改善を示さず、対象系統との妥当な技術接続も確認できない。

records.title: NL2Repo-Bench: Towards Long-Horizon Repository Generation Evaluation of Coding Agents
records.reason: The primary text introduces a long-horizon repository-generation benchmark and evaluates coding-agent task completion. It does not propose or test KV-cache compression or serving efficiency.

records.title: Memory OS of AI Agent
records.reason: The primary text presents a hierarchical external-memory system for conversational agents, adjacent to long-context/KV-memory lineages. Its evaluations measure response coherence and personalization, not KV-cache footprint or inference-resource savings.

records.title: Learning Intrinsic Sparse Structures within Long Short-term Memory
records.reason: The primary full text shows structured LSTM compression with same-perplexity Penn Treebank language modeling and a large CPU speedup. It is a concrete recurrent-LM inference result, but its gate/hidden-state mechanism does not directly transfer to current Transformer LLMs.
